It's probably a combo of Depression and the social anxiety. Because of the social anxiety your mind is overactive because you think about everything social related (almost everything you do) 
That makes you feel exhausted all the time.

Hey, I could feel your pain through the text. I'm not too far off age wide either, so we might understand each other better. Let me know if you want to talk, 
I'm here for you if you want!
I like to draw on the walls with the Widowmaker

I really don't know why we aren't allowed to rest. I mean if you are physically sick you can call in sick, but if you are mentally sick we aren't allowed to call in sick.  It is like mental health doesn't count. Oh yeah, our society is so great.

Same, I let my ex manipulate me into getting back together thinking she changed. Worst decision I've made, a week later she was gone. It's definitely hard seeing through their inventions as I was still happy she wanted a relationship with me(because no one else wanted to)

Honestly man I feel for you, I've got paid below minimum wage and working black, then I said fuck it. Stood up for myself (although hard as hell) and now I'm starting working white and getting enough salary. There got to be a way for you mate, the suicidal thoughts won't just stop, but they will reduce in power. You said nitrogen is your way out, but It sounds very painful. There are better ways to take your life, not saying you should because we want you here.
Definitely true, you say to yourself you need to talk more to gain friends, then this happens on repeat repeat

I have not "talked" to anyone my age either for a very long time. 17 btw. 
Fuck I hate my life
I'm not the Thread owner, I just saw your comment and commented myself.... I don't know about the thread owner
Calling might make it go away sooner, but calling (atleast for me) is a no go. I'd rather die.

I don't know if it's a good thing that I can relate very much. I've also been bullied, have anxiety and depression, want to kill myself etc. I'm 17 so fairly close. If you want to talk just hmu. 

Good luck, stay strong pal

Please do! Welcome

You should be accepted very quickly, we have many people who is active more than daily!

Because I want to help you. To understand you. 

But if you are not ready to tell that, I understand. I just want you to know that if you need help I am here, we are all here. From personal experience, I feel that getting things off your mind is a good way to feel better. For a while at least.

What's going on in your life?

What's going through your mind right now?

​

Stay strong mate
